nodes.label: Potato Plant Photo (Kentang)
nodes.description: Photograph of a potato plant (Solanum tuberosum). Broadleaf agricultural crop from the Solanaceae family. Image shows poor-to-moderate plant health with visible yellowing (chlorosis), brown/dark spots or necrotic areas, and possible margin browning. Symptoms consistent with possible early blight (Alternaria solani), late blight (Phytophthora infestans), or nutrient deficiency.

edges.note: Both are Solanaceae family crops sharing similar disease profiles (late blight, early blight)
Kentang plant photo is displayed as a selection card on the home/plant selection screen
Kentang photo relates to the disease detection app workflow documented in Panduan
